summary: Learn partner segmentation, conflict management, PRM workflows, and channel KPIs in 5 days. Build tools you can apply immediately.
lede: Channel partner sales management covers how to recruit, enable, and govern resellers, distributors, agents, and referral partners. It is for channel sales, partner, marketing, distribution, and sales operations professionals who manage partner performance and indirect revenue. Practical work includes segmenting and selecting partners, planning onboarding and deal registration, and using scorecards, dashboards, and quarterly reviews to track channel health.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who already work with partners, distributors, resellers, or indirect sales channels and now need a more structured way to manage performance, incentives, and governance.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: working knowledge of sales operations, partner selling, or revenue management; comfort reading CRM or channel performance reports; and familiarity with commercial targets and pipeline terminology. No coding or programming is required. Participants should ideally bring a laptop and, where possible, a sample partner scorecard, partner plan, or channel KPI report for workshop use.
